run_GetCommandOutput: run the GetCommandOutput function to execute a shell command and return its stdout as a list of lines
build_GetSvnInfo: build a call to GetSvnInfo to extract the project name and SVN workspace root path from svn info output
test_GetSvnTrunk: test the GetSvnTrunk function to retrieve the current SVN workspace's trunk root path
review_IsInGTestSvn: review the IsInGTestSvn function to check if the current directory is within a googletest SVN workspace
summarize_IsInGMockSvn: summarize the IsInGMockSvn function to determine if the current directory is within a googlemock SVN workspace
